description: This PHP class 'ProjectDao' in the 'OrangeHRM\Time\Dao' namespace handles database operations related to project management within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting projects, and generating various project reports, including filtering by parameters such as project ID, customer, employee number, and date ranges, often utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders.

classes.name: ProjectDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing 'Project' entities and related report data in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and report generation.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persists a Project entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteProjects
methods.description: Marks multiple projects as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Project by its ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingProjectIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing, non-deleted project IDs matching provided IDs.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getProjectsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of projects matching filter criteria.

methods.name: isProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a project name is already used for a specific customer, excluding a given project ID.

methods.name: isProjectAdmin
methods.description: Verifies if an employee is assigned as a project administrator.

methods.name: getProjectIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all project IDs, with optional inclusion of deleted projects.

methods.name: getProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns project IDs accessible to a specified project admin, optionally including deleted projects.

methods.name: hasTimesheetItemsForProject
methods.description: Checks if a project has any associated timesheet items.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Retrieves project report criteria based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of project report entries matching report filters.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration for project reports based on filters.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Retrieves detailed project activity reports based on filters.

methods.name: getProjectReportActivityDetailedCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts detailed project activity report entries.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectActivityDetailedReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration for detailed project activity reports.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Gets employee numbers accessible to a given project admin.

methods.name: getUnselectableProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieves project IDs that cannot be selected, typically those with associated timesheet items.

methods.name: getActivityIdsOfProjectInTimesheetItems
methods.description: Fetches activity IDs associated with a specific project in timesheet entries.
